instruction: Trusted controller resource policy autonomy-turn-policy-v2: there is no limit on the number of AI turns per claim, including paper intake. This policy supersedes references to a 25-attempt ceiling or fixed attempt limits in historical prompt text, initial requests and prior feedback. Attempt numbers are cumulative audit counters, never stopping criteria. Continue informative authorized work while the controller admits it within the current server-recorded funding authorization and original seven-day deadline. An explicit null aggregate ceiling means unlimited funding; a finite recorded ceiling remains binding. The global default is unlimited under the operator authorization, while all reservations and available usage remain recorded. Never reset commitments, deadlines, turn numbers or prior evidence. Missing inputs, unconfirmed provider outcomes, unavailable authorization and exhausted subscription allowance still require their specific honest blockers; removing the turn cap does not authorize replaying uncertain calls, paid fallback or repeated sampling for a preferred finding. The controller alone admits each call and experiment. Scientific criteria and evidence coverage remain unchanged.
